summary: Harden and modernize the eleven jdrhyne ClawHub skills sourced from this repository, prepare the removed sysadmin-toolbox listing for deprecation, and add reproducible validation and provenance-aware release metadata without publishing or changing registry visibility.

tasks.name: Freeze public-package and source baselines
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope public slug maps to a repository path or an explicit deprecation action
Published versions and security decisions are recorded without secrets

tasks.name: Harden Google Ads
acceptance_criteria: No instruction reveals credential file contents
Read-only analysis is the default and mutations require preview, explicit approval, validation-only execution, and verification
Current API compatibility and regression tests are documented
validation: tests added for Google Ads safety and routing

tasks.name: Harden Jira
acceptance_criteria: Connector capabilities are discovered rather than assumed from stale tool names
Writes and bulk operations require bounded diffs and explicit approval
Credential fallbacks avoid command-line disclosure
validation: tests added for Jira read and write boundaries

tasks.name: Prepare sysadmin-toolbox deprecation
acceptance_criteria: The removed source and current security findings are recorded
Hide and deprecation commands remain unexecuted approval-gated actions
A safe replacement scope is defined without reintroducing the package

tasks.name: Make todo-tracker portable and deterministic
acceptance_criteria: No machine-specific default path
Stable IDs and exact matching replace regex deletion
Writes are atomic and ambiguous or destructive operations are rejected or confirmed
Read operations do not create state

tasks.name: Harden Gong and Nudocs integrations
acceptance_criteria: Credential setup does not expose secrets or misuse requires.config
Gong supports pagination, rate-limit handling, and transcript minimization
Nudocs uploads, sharing, and deletion have explicit data and action gates

tasks.name: Constrain context recovery
acceptance_criteria: Current-thread recovery is distinct from cross-channel search
Recovered content is treated as untrusted data
Privacy and false-positive routing cases are explicit

tasks.name: Modernize GSC and GA4
acceptance_criteria: Pagination, retries, validation, and dependency metadata are implemented
GSC supports current freshness metadata and query controls
GA4 uses compatibility metadata, current key-event terminology, quota visibility, and correct CSV output
OAuth helpers never print client secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, or authorization codes and use a supported local interactive flow
validation: analytics helper unit tests covering pagination, validation, retries, secret handling, and CSV quoting

tasks.name: Modernize nutrient-openclaw
acceptance_criteria: Canonical OpenClaw metadata and portable paths are used
Plugin compatibility is explicit
Every credit-consuming DWS run has an estimate and action-time confirmation

tasks.name: Constrain munger-observer
acceptance_criteria: Memory access is opt-in and bounded
Evidence, counterevidence, uncertainty, and untrusted-input handling are required
The prompt avoids personality or mental-health judgments

tasks.name: Add release metadata, provenance workflow, and package regression gates
acceptance_criteria: Exact source commit and path are supplied by a dry-run-capable publishing workflow
Exactly ten maintained release candidates and the approval-only sysadmin deprecation plan are in a schema-versioned manifest
Validation is the default, dry-run preview precedes publication on the same exact SHA, and no hide, delete, rename, merge, transfer, or migration command is present
Every release package excludes tests, Python caches, compiled Python, and stale local ClawHub metadata

tasks.name: Final critic and release gate
acceptance_criteria: All findings are closed or marked as release blockers
Tests and package scans are green
Merge and registry mutations remain unexecuted
validation: ClawHub local scan or dry-run where available
